title: Binance Will List Vulcan Forged PYR (PYR)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Vulcan Forged PYR (PYR) and will open trading for PYR/BTC, PYR/BUSD, and PYR/USDT trading pairs at 2021-11-26 08:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  PYR  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for PYR will open at 2021-11-27 08:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Vulcan Forged PYR (PYR)? Vulcan Forged is a game studio dedicated to NFT games built on Ethereum and Polygon. Amongst its series of games on the platform, VulcanVerse and Berserk are the 2 main games of the project. PYR is its native utility token, which allows users to purchase NFTs from the in-game marketplace, participate in staking and pay for scholar registration fees. PYR Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
